title: Relational time: conditional states of a stationary global state relative to a ring clock

key_results.statement: the statistics of every place-partition reading are $\lambda$-independent iff $\langle K\vert\rho_\omega\vert K\rangle=0$ for every joint place $K$ and every Bohr frequency $\omega\neq0$

an eigenvector of $C$ satisfies (3.2), but the converse fails: $\lvert f_0\rangle\otimes(\alpha\lvert r_1\rangle+\beta\lvert r_2\rangle)$ with $C_R$ diagonal in the places of $R$ has constant place statistics without being stationary
for starts obeying (3.2), $p(r\vert m)$ of a reading on $R$ right after a clock reading is $\lambda$-independent and depends on $m$ iff the joint place distribution of $K$ and $R$ is not a product

eigenvector $\Psi_{\rm ex}=(\lvert f_1\rangle\otimes\lvert+\rangle+\lvert f_0\rangle\otimes\lvert-\rangle)/\sqrt2$ with $C_R=\frac{2\pi}{N\lambda_0}\lvert-\rangle\langle-\rvert$ gives $p(0_R\vert m)=\cos^2(\pi m/N)$: the clock outcome changes statistics on $R$
an eigenvector with eigenvalue $E$ and $\Phi(0)\propto\chi$ exists iff $\chi\in\bigoplus_{s\in S_E}Q_s\mathcal H_R$; it is then unique up to phase
the statistics of every reading on $R$ in $\Phi(m)/\lVert\Phi(m)\rVert$ equal those of $e^{-iC_R\lambda}\chi$ at $\lambda=m\lambda_0$: $P_r(m)=p_r(m\lambda_0)$

coincidence set $\Lambda_m\supseteq m\lambda_0+(N\lambda_0/g_\chi)\mathbb Z\supseteq m\lambda_0+N\lambda_0\mathbb Z$; the middle set is where the states coincide, and $\Lambda_m$ can be larger (e.g. $\pm m\lambda_0+N\lambda_0\mathbb Z$ in (3.5))
if $e^{-iC\lambda_0}=S\otimes W$ with $W$ unitary on $\mathcal H_R$, then $\Phi(m+1)=e^{iE\lambda_0}W\Phi(m)$ for every eigenvector of $C$

(3.14) holds for $C_\partial=\sum_k\lvert f_k\rangle\langle f_k\rvert\otimes B_k$ with $e^{-i(C_R+B_k)\lambda_0}=W$ for all $k$, e.g. $B_k=\frac{2\pi n_k}{\lambda_0}P$ with $[P,C_R]=0$, giving $W=e^{-iC_R\lambda_0}$

for $N=2$, $C_R=0$, $C_\partial=gZ\otimes\lvert0\rangle\langle0\rvert_R$, the eigenvector $(\sqrt{p_+}\lvert0\rangle-\sqrt{p_-}\lvert1\rangle)\otimes\lvert0\rangle_R$ has $p_\pm=\frac12(1\pm g/\Omega)$ unequal, so no unitary $U$ with $\Phi(m+1)=U\Phi(m)$ exists

$[P_r(m+1)-P_r(m)]/\lambda_0=\mathrm dp_r/\mathrm d\lambda\vert_{\lambda=\tau_m}+\delta$ with $\lvert\delta\rvert\le\lambda_0w_\chi^2/2$, valid for eigenvectors under (3.14) with $W\propto e^{-iC_R\lambda_0}$

open_issues: Readings are place partitions, so λ-independence of all statistics (3.2) is weaker than stationarity; relational evolution for non-eigenvector starts obeying (3.2) is not treated.
The coincidence set Λ_m (3.13) is characterized only through place moduli; no closed form beyond the two inclusions.
Item 3 gives only a sufficient condition (3.14); a necessary and sufficient condition on the crossing contract is not determined, and the realization (3.15) needs a fine-tuned spectrum of the B_k.
The rate conversion (3.18) is a statement on clock steps; the N samples do not determine p_r between ticks, and the clock resolution belongs to criterion 1.
Superpositions of eigenvectors with different eigenvalues are not treated.

consistency_checks.check: Dimensions (Cλ, k_s, λ0·w_χ dimensionless) and normalization (Σ p(m) = 1, p₊ + p₋ = 1)
χ an eigenvector of C_R: product eigenvector, m-independent conditional statistics, Λ_m = ℝ, δ = 0
N = 2 in example (3.5): shift relation (3.6) reproduces Φ(1) = −|1⟩/√2 and P_0(1) = 0 = p_0(λ0)
